description.p: Gemini Desktop is a desktop client for Google Gemini, built for Linux desktop environments with native window controls, system tray integration, and sandboxed web isolation. Keep Google Gemini quickly accessible with Wayland and X11 support, native desktop notifications, and PipeWire screen sharing.

ul.li: Native Linux window integration with frameless and titlebar mode options
System tray support with minimize-to-tray and quick-toggle CLI
Wayland and X11 display support (auto-detected with Chromium flag override)
Screen sharing support via PipeWire on Wayland and X11
Native desktop notifications and permission prompts
Autostart on login and configurable window frame style
Automatic update notifications from GitHub Releases
Light and dark Material 3 desktop settings interface

description.p: Initial Linux release featuring isolated browser views with strict sandboxing, Material 3 Linux settings and control chrome, Wayland and X11 display support, PipeWire screen sharing, system tray and quick-toggle support, and native Debian (.deb) and AppImage packaging.
